newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm as investors buy TEMs.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm as investors buy TEMs.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 477.00/478.00 per dollar as investors switched out of dollars to buy TEMs at the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction, traders said.
On Tuesday, the bolivar closed at 477.75/478.75 per dollar.
"There was a strong effect on the exchange market from foreign investors buying TEMs," said one trader.
The Central Bank sold 100 billion bolivars of TEMs in an auction that saw yields on benchmark six-month paper rise 12 basis points to 18.93 percent.
Traders said strong Central Bank intervention in the exchange market also helped support the bolivar.
